publicTables.description: Tables the public renderer reads without a tenant context; every other tenant table carries forced RLS (ADR-039).

platformTables.description: Tables whose rows name an organization but belong to the platform, not to that tenant: written before a tenant is known (ADR-041), or written on the module's own connection with a bare organization_id erased through register_erasure_rows (ADR-068).

roleGrants.description: Permissions this module adds to each system role. The module's own migration grants them in the database (ADR-049).

appointmentKinds.description: Kinds of visit this module adds to booking, as {key: label} (ADR-049).

appointmentKindsWithOwnMaterials.description: Of this module's appointmentKinds, those whose materials the module accounts for itself (e.g. per animal in field work): booking neither takes products for them nor settles them at completion (ADR-055).

appointmentKindsCompletedExplicitly.description: Of this module's appointmentKinds, those that took place only once completed (the module closes them, e.g. when field work ends): a visit of such a kind whose time passed without completion is not counted as done (UX-031). "" names the plain service without a kind, for a product whose every visit is closed that way.

appointmentsOfOthersPermission.description: A permission this module declares that opens other people's visits (UX-023). Without it, whoever does not plan visits (booking.appointment.manage) sees only the visits they are on — e.g. a doctor does not see another doctor's patients. Left out: everyone who reads the calendar sees everyone's visits.

middleware.description: Middleware classes of this module, mounted after the tenant middleware only where the module is composed (ADR-049). Must live in the module's own app.

beatSchedule.description: Scheduled work of this module as {name: {task, schedule}}; schedule in seconds (ADR-049). Tasks must live in the module's own app.
